provenance.source: Toyota Motor Corporation, Toyota Premieres GR Yaris (news release, 10 January 2020)
provenance.notes: The GR Yaris is the TOYOTA GAZOO Racing version of the Yaris.

provenance.source: Toyota Motor Corporation, Toyota Celebrates Launch of New GR Yaris in Japan with Virtual Event (news release, September 2020)
provenance.notes: Start of the generation: on sale in Japan from 4 September 2020.

provenance.source: TOYOTA GAZOO Racing, Sales of Evolved GR Yaris to Start in April (news release, 21 March 2024)
provenance.notes: Mid-cycle update of the GR Yaris, presented in January 2024 and on sale in Japan from 8 April 2024.

provenance.source: Toyota Motor Corporation, TGR to Launch Evolved GR Yaris (news release, 11 April 2025)
provenance.notes: Further partial upgrade from May 2025, with the eight-speed GR-DAT automatic. The type designation stays GXPA16, so the 2024 and 2025 updates stay in the same generation.

provenance.source: Toyota Motor Corporation, GR Yaris main specifications (Japan, October 2025)
provenance.notes: Type designation 4BA-GXPA16 of the updated car, the same code as the first cars.

provenance.source: Wikidata: Toyota (Q53268), Toyota Yaris (Q6902966), Toyota GR Yaris (Q96335350)
provenance.notes: External ids of the make and the model; the GR Yaris item describes it as a variant of the Yaris.
